There wasn't much time, for the world is dark and full of horrors. The spectra were still a divided people, with only a single point of gathering in the Southern Forest. New spectra roamed the lands of Gaea, lost and forlorn. Luminus knew things had to change. He could not bear to see his race so lost, without purpose. There would be unity, and with unity, strength.

Luminus saw all of this, from the day when he first entered the clearing this was his goal, his purpose. So too did he alone could not accomplish what he had desired, his form was lacking in the capacity to unify a people.

This crystal changes all that, that and the first magic. With the two combined, Luminus could be so much more. His dream, nae, his obsession could finally be fulfilled. The spectra would have a beacon, a light shining through the darkness. This too, was the miracle of a new beginning.

Luminus smiled, he has finally known enough knowledge of the Crystal of Reflection to do what he must do. With the crystal of reflection in one hand, and the carefully prepared seed crystal in the other, Luminus began to pray.

"Cruxius, Lord of the Crossroads, I request safe passage through your realm. In the far reaches, miles and miles away from here there is a land where our people may grow in number and in strength. Hence, I must ask for your assistance, to ensure the survival and strength of my race. I humbly request of you a portal to [the mouth of the Heavy places, where the land meets the sea.](http://savagegods.net/gaea_political.svg)" (31J)

Luminus waited, then gasped in wonder as the Primrose path was shown to him. He closed his eyes and stepped through the portal.

*****

When Luminus re-opened his senses, he stood where his dreams always led him, the meeting of Land and Sea, a great mouth, a natural harbor. As he lifted into the air, he felt that it took more effort than it did just moments before. This was the promised land, this was the heavy lands.

He smiled at the pilgrimage appearing behind him, for he knew they would arrive. The pilgrims were all builders, geniuses amongst the spectra. They would be able to found the city after his task here was complete.

This too, he communicated to the bewildered pilgrims, and gave them the knowledge to allow them to build with the stones of the land, out of the crystal hidden within the earth.

Then, with resolute purpose, he strolled to the spot where his dreams always had him stand. With a swift and fluid motion, he stabbed the seed crystal into the ground, and began to gather the knowledge stored in the recesses of the Crystal of Reflection.

This was the magic of change, of transformation.

The seed crystal began to shift, it changed from a simple, perfect crystal and began to reflect the properties of the Crystal of Reflection, it would not be a perfect copy, Luminus never intended it to be. The crystal continued to change until it became what was required, an antenna, a physical amplifier of the very power Luminus and all spectra wielded with their minds. It too would allow the spectra to see their own minds, and to understand, but not to change.

Then Luminus willed it to grow, and grow, and grow. Using the energy he had stored in his vine, and drawing from the power of Gaea itself, the crystal became a tower. As the tower formed around him, he felt his very form turn to crystal. This too, was predicted. Such was the price of power, but it will also serve a purpose.

As the tower formed, Luminus fused with it, becoming one with the crystalline tower that formed from the soil, his very mind was the crystal's mind, and the crystal an amplifier of his will.

Thus the [Crystal Tower](http://orig04.deviantart.net/9b86/f/2009/289/6/2/the_awakening_ii_crystal_tower_by_cygx1.jpg) came into being, a great beacon, broadcasting its location, a sirens call for the lonely spectra of the world, a way for the spectra to hear each other's voices, to speak with one another from oceans away. A centerpiece for a civilization.

However, the magic was not done, the structure was not perfect. The magic resonated within the heavy lands, expanding outwards, working eternally. Like the Heavy Lands, and like those who lived within it, this structure would change. Its form never static, never certain, never still.

The pilgrims looked in wonder at this new creation, they heard its call for all spectra to come to the promised land. Inspired by his act of creation, they too began to build.

Such was the beginning of the Free City of Sentenza.

When dawn came that fateful day, there was only a landscape, an empty place where the land met the sea.

When the dawn of the next day came, some time later, there was the beginning of a great civilization.

For the rest of the world, it was just the dawn of another day. For the spectra, this was the beginning of a new era.
